caveats: The phone was not attached for this run: the comparison uses the checked-in physical-device capture below. It is real moto g35 data, but it is not a fresh replay; re-run with the phone attached to refresh it.

Recorded agent-device snapshots do not expose the framework decor chrome (action bar container/toolbar, status/navigation bar backgrounds) that a live `uiautomator dump` does; those ids are allowlisted as a capture-tool scope difference (fixtures/reference-device/COMPARISON.md).

differences.allow_reason: The phone is 1080x2400 @400dpi = 432x960dp; the ACOS reference session is 1080x2400 @420dpi = 411x914dp. A node that spans the display (the window root) necessarily has a different dp extent. Bounds are compared in dp so that dp-sized children match exactly; this single entry covers the one node whose size is the display itself.

API 35 draws the app window edge-to-edge (bottom == display bottom); the API-34 image ends the app window above the navigation bar. The comparator marks a full-width node that reaches the phone's display bottom but not ACOS's as `edge_to_edge`; the app's own dp layout inside it still has to match. Evidence: fixtures/reference-device/COMPARISON.md ("API 35 vs API 34 ... shift the content origin").

API 35 draws the app window edge-to-edge (bottom == display bottom); the API-34 image ends the app window above the navigation bar. The comparator marks a full-width node that reaches the phone's display bottom but not ACOS's as `edge_to_edge`; the app's own dp layout inside it still has to match. Evidence: fixtures/reference-device/COMPARISON.md ("API 35 vs API 34 ... shift the content origin").

The status bar band is 128 px (48.8 dp) on the API-34 image and 108 px (43.2 dp) on the Android 15 phone, so the whole app frame sits ~5.6 dp higher on the phone and every node in it is translated by that amount. The comparator measures the frame shift from `android:id/content`'s top-left edge and marks a size-preserving translation with it; a node that moved by anything else is not covered by this entry.
